Saarijärvi hut-specific guidance is stricter about outdoor fire/no official fire site and firewood for hut heating. Luontoon/Retkikartta exposes a new Saarijärvi waste-storage structure, but Eräluvat/hut guidance can still say visitors must pack out waste or that no waste management is provided.

Malla Strict Nature Reserve rules are stricter than Käsivarsi rules but apply only if modeling the Malla/Three-Country Cairn alternate or connector, not the main Kilpisjärvi-Saarijärvi stage by default.
